units.source_text: “老板娘，您别相信那种女人的话，她还是照样打我弟弟。

en.t: Madam innkeeper, please don't believe what that woman says; she is still beating my younger brother just the same.

units.source_text: 我弟弟身上青一块紫一块，共有五六处呢。”

en.t: My younger brother has bruises all over him, black and blue, five or six places in all.
